shared_elements: carved stone surface with incised/low-relief linework
anthropomorphic figure with head and body
long hair or beard rendered as rows of parallel strands/curls
upright rectangular format dominated by a single figure
justification: Both are single anthropomorphic figures carved in stone, and both use rows of parallel curl-like strands for hair and include a prominent circular disc motif on the body, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a flat, shallow-relief panel with a finely detailed winged figure in strict profile, while B is a massive blocky three-dimensional statue seen frontally with coarse, heavily eroded, schematic incision.
